articleTitle: Modeling and Research of Automatic Sun Tracking System on the bases of IoT and Arduino UNO
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, IoT-based solar panel automatic modeling is modeled on the Proteus software environment. IoT based automatic Sun Tracker systems depend on the angle of descent of the sun's rays on the surface of the active energy is described. Modeling the solar panels and power systems require self-propelled driving equipment are designed for maximum output energy. Furthermore, power system on the Proteus software environment is modeled to a model of the automatic solar tracking system and the assembly scheme. The Automatic Sun Tracking system moving in relation to solar radiation, is researched by taking into account the load requirements.

articleTitle: Implementation Of Object-Oriented Programming Technology In The One-Dimensional Oil Displacement Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The methodology of object-oriented programming technology is briefly described and the results of its application to the problem of modeling on a computer a one-dimensional oil displacement process in the framework of the mathematical model of Liss and Rapoport of two-phase filtering are presented. Computer analogues of real-world objects such as injection wells, production wells, and oil-bearing media between wells have been constructed and used. Performed computational experiments to simulate the process of oil displacement by using a program developed on the basis of object-oriented technology. The results of computational experiments are presented.

articleTitle: Results of Calculations of Parameters of Reliability of Restored Devices of the Multiservice Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article made the calculation of the statistical evaluation of the coefficient of readiness and the results of the calculation. The definition of a multiservice communication network is given, the purpose of each level of the network and their main equipment are given. The main reliability indicators devices of access layer are presented and calculated, such as: the failure flow parameter, the time between failures, the availability factor K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>, the technical utilization factor, the forced down time factor, the operational readiness factor K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">O.G.</sub>. Brief recommendations on the choice of methodology for calculating reliability indicators of telecommunications network equipment are given.

Author Keywords: agreement on the level (quality) of providing network services

articleTitle: Research and Modelling Adaptive Management of Hybrid Power Supply Systems for Object Telecommunications based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article materials of research and modelling adaptive management of hybrid power supply systems for object telecommunications based IoT are given. The modeling process of energy conversion based on solar, wind, diesel, centralized and batteries energy sources based on physical technical effects are shown. Algorithm and imitation model uses the Proteus software of adaptive management hybrid power supply systems for object telecommunication based on IoT are made.

articleTitle: Power Providing Methods For Wireless Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Nowdays, there is an active search around the world for new environmentally friendly and unlimited energy resources that will allow network devices to get rid of batteries or wires, and develop autonomous wireless sensor networks with a theoretically unlimited service life The article discusses a possible option of organizing power supply to nodes of wireless sensor networks from the energy of electromagnetic radiation.

articleTitle: The Importance Of Mobile Applications In The Use Of Standard Water Measurements
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is dedicated to improving the speed and accuracy of measuring and monitoring works, with using standard water metering devices for irrigation networks, which includes the analysis of water shortages and the selection of measuring devices, the analysis of a number of shortcomings in use. It also focuses on the importance of information and communication technologies, the usage guidelines and prospects for efficient use of water metering devices in irrigation networks and increasing the efficiency of monitoring operations.

articleTitle: Calculation of losses for transpiration in water reservoirs with using new computer technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Reservoirs are important object for the agriculture and national economy of Uzbekistan. In this article provided hydraulic and hydrological calculations of loss in water reservoirs with using new methodologies and computer technologies. Novelty of the research is modernizing calculation method. With this gotten high accuracy data. In calculations of los for transpiration in other researches counts only transpiration of water surface. With using CropWat model it is possible to calculate evaporation and transpiration.

articleTitle: Evaluation of erosion and accumulative process with using Geoinformation systems in water resource management
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the issues of monitoring and control in the field of water management, which is the basis of the rational use of water resources (rivers), the efficient use of modern GIS (geographic information system) for the effective control over the state of irrigation systems. In researches used Landsat satellite data and new information techniques and technologies. Determinate hydraulic and hydrological parameters of flow. The results were compared with the data in the field.

articleTitle: 5g Technology Evolution
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, an attempt has been made to review various existing generations of mobile wireless technology in terms of their portals, performance, advantages and disadvantages. The paper throws light on the evolution and development of various generations of mobile wireless technology along with their significance and advantages of one over the other. In the past few decades, mobile wireless technologies have experience 4 or 5 generations of technology revolution and evolution, namely from 1G to 4G. Current research in mobile wireless technology concentrates on advance implementation of 4G technology and 5G technology. Currently 5G term is not officially used. In 5G research is being made on development of World-Wide Wireless Web (WWWW), Dynamic Adhoc Wireless Networks (DAWN) and Real Wireless World. In this paper we propose novel network architecture for next generation 5G mobile networks.. In the proposed architecture the mobile terminal has the possibility to change the Radio Access Technology - RAT based on certain user criteria.

articleTitle: Innovative approach of distance learning in the form of online courses
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the role of the online form of education in today's conditions of informationalization of society, the importance of online education as one of the forms of basic and additional education is deduced, the role of the interaction of traditional professional education and its innovative online forms is shown. It also analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the distance view of the educational process in comparison with the traditional education system, the potential difficulties and positive aspects of using online learning.

articleTitle: Logical method for constructing the optimal corrector of fuzzy heuristic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of correcting the sets of fuzzy heuristic algorithms in weakly formalized domains is investigated in the paper. The mathematical formulation of the problem of constructing the optimal corrector of heuristic algorithms is given. The scheme of constructing the corrector optimal on the control material is given. The consideration of individual heuristics are also studied in the paper as unreliable working parts of an information processing system, where several different heuristics are accepted to solve the same task, and the obtained results are corrected in a certain way.

articleTitle: Faster RCNN Detection Based OpenCV CSRT Tracker Using Drone Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Object tracking is one of the well-known topic in Computer Vision sphere with challenging and problematic tasks that frames come with problems like overlapping, camera motion blur, changing object appearance, environmental variations and so on. Using OpenCV based CSRT (Channel and Spatial Reliability Tracking) tracker itself, without integration object detection part may face problems which mentioned above. To overcome that challenges we integrated deep learning based object detection with CSRT tracker and got better tracking results.

articleTitle: Biomedical signals interpolation spline models
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to the study of the properties of Biomedicine signals and the construction of splayn models, which are considered important in signal processing. The cube spline models signals of biomedicine interpretive high rate of accuracy, If this is the case, treating infected patients can make the right decision as appropriate. As an example, it was taken initial experimental information of ECG signals and based on this information, a local interpolation cubic spline model was constructed. The process of interpolation of ECG signal carried out with the help of this model.

articleTitle: A Method of Mapping a Block of Main Memory to Cache in Parallel Processing of the Speech Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method for optimal using the multi-core processor cache in parallel processing of signals and achieving to maximum speed up. Acceleration problems have not been fully resolved till present. One of the most actual tasks is the creation of fast algorithms using multicore processors, especially in the field of digital signal processing. The proposed method is designed for parallel processing of speech signals based on spectral analysis. Input signals are processed by splitting frames using a new parallel algorithm. Intel's advanced tools, such as TBB and OpenMP, were used to create fast algorithms. The results of parallel processing acceleration were analyzed. Also, the problem of optimizing the cache memory of multi-core processors was analyzed in parallel processing tasks. For hardware implementations were chosen quad-core and eight-core processors. The results showed that when the signal frame size corresponds to the size of the L3 cache blocks, the acceleration of the calculation of the signal spectrum becomes closer to the number of processor cores.

articleTitle: Estimation affects of formats and resizing process to the accuracy of convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: image quality, formatting, resizing and compression processes affect on deep neural network performance. These affects are investigated in many papers. However, signal represented images do not look like images which were captured by a camera, because they were plotted in a computer, which let to omit some noises. So formatting and resizing processes are important parameters that affect on network accuracy. In this work, ECG signal representation in different domains were saved in different image formats and CNN trained on these images. Obtained results were compared and showed that JPG image format best fits for training ECG images on CNN.

articleTitle: An Overview of Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Data visualization is a general term that describes any effort to help people understand the significance of data by placing it in a visual context. Patterns, trends and correlations that might go undetected in text-based data can be exposed and recognized easier with data visualization software. Data visualization is the presentation of quantitative information in a graphical form. In other words, data visualizations turn large and small data-sets into visuals that are easier for the human brain to understand and process. Data visualizations are surprisingly common in our everyday life, but they often appear in the form of well-known charts and graphs. It can be used to discover unknown facts and trends. Good data visualizations are created when communication, data science, and design collide. Data visualizations done right offer key insights into complicated data-sets in ways that are meaningful and intuitive. In this article, we would like to discuss about data visualization, importance of data visualization, data visualization tools etc.

articleTitle: Principle Of Organizing Database Identification On Mobile Devices By Imei
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the possibility of creating a Unified IMEI mobile device identification database information system, which will be able to analyze, monitor and control imported mobile devices, which will help to reduce crimes related to theft by blocking stolen mobile devices in Uzbekistan.

articleTitle: Model For Building Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In order to develop algorithms for wireless sensor networks and in order to give mathematical correctness and performance proofs, models for various aspects of sensor networks are needed. Generally, finding good models is a challenging task. On the one hand, a model should be as simple as possible such that the analysis of a given algorithm remains tractable. On the other hand, however, a model must not be too simplistic in the sense that it neglects important properties of the network. A great algorithm in theory may be inefficient or even incorrect in practice if the analysis is based on idealistic assumptions.

articleTitle: Display Integrated Mobile Phone Prototype For Blind People
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Mobile phones based on GSM technology for blind people are available worldwide. GSM phones have Braille keypad with large keys that helps blind people to understand the digits and the presence of voice response for key press helps them to understand the numbers. The proposed prototype allows the blind to easily use mobile phones for voice calls, as well as messaging. This paper presents the development of a new phone which is designed to help blind and visually impaired people make phone calls. This phone is beneficial through its innovative concept, its simplicity, and its availability at an affordable cost.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional Model of the Reaction-Diffusion with Nonlocal Interaction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, numerical solutions are used to construct solutions of a two-dimensional RD equation with a nonlocal nonlinearity for initial distributions with several localization centers. The choice of the initial distributions corresponds to the experimental conditions in which inoculation of the bacterial culture is carried out at the center of localization of the initial distribution. The results obtained in the study of a one-dimensional non-local model created the necessary background for studying the formation of two-dimensional population structures under the influence of nonlocal interaction. Two-dimensional structures are most convenient for experimental studies.

articleTitle: Measurement Of Electromagnetic Radiation Levels From Mobile Radiotelephones
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, a comparative analysis of the level of electromagnetic load from transmitting radio engineering objects, base stations of cellular communications and mobile radio communications (mobile phones) is carried out.

articleTitle: Development of Smart City Model: Smart Bus System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Our purpose is contributing to the smart city model which is highly demanded by many organizations myriad number of organizations for developed cities in the world to significantly amplify and ameliorate the quality of life of the occupants, improve the utilization of city resources and reduce the operational prize. This model is used in urban places and it helps us to do the things which take our time and in this way it alleviates our job. Including different kinds of heterogeneous technologies such as Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), Internet of Things (IoT), Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), Cloud Computing, and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). However, to reach these important objectives, efficient networking and communication protocols are needed to provide the necessary coordination and control of the various system components, this model can produce various benefits. In this paper, we give some information about the model and present some new ideas to develop the smart city.

articleTitle: Implementation of a mathematical model of a hexacopter control system
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The implementation of a mathematical model of a hexacopter control system is considered in the paper. Results are obtained in the form of graphs and three-dimensional animation of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flight using the MatLab Simulink software package. An unmanned aerial vehicle is considered as a control object, on which various external forces act.

Index Terms: Speed Of The Unmanned Aerial Vehicles

articleTitle: A Method of Efficient OTP Generation Using Pseudorandom Number Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Something you know based authentication method is the most classical authentication technique on the computer system, and is performed more easily and successfully than other methods even it is a vulnerable method against attacks such as eavesdropping or replay attack. To solve this problem, OTP (Onetime Password) technique is used. OTP is delivered from one side to the other in two approaches. In the first approach, OTP is generated on server side and sent to clients, for example, by SMS. In the second approach, OTP is generated on both sides at one time based on shared counter, such as, HOTP. In most cases, one-way hash functions are used in both approaches to generate OTP. As resent researches show the weakness of the hash functions, we need new a new OTP generation algorithms to solve this problem. In this paper, we propose a method of creating one time password based on pseudorandom number generators (PRNG), which they are exist on many systems and programming languages as native.

articleTitle: Parallel Signal Processing Based-On Graphics Processing Units
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article analyzes parallel implementation of GPU in the process of generating speech spectrogram images, which is most commonly used as a parameter in speech recognition. The convenience of generating and recognizing spectrogram images from speech signals is that they are rich in character sets compared to other speech recognition methods. Therefore, most modern speech recognition systems use spectrograms. Based on the results of the experiment, it can be seen that the production of spectrogram images from speech signals in the graphics processor was faster than the central processor. This will improve the quality of speech recognition and identification in real time.

articleTitle: Mathematical simulation and the methods to assess the strength of earth dams
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The methods to study the stress-strain state (SSS) and to assess the strength of earth dams under the influence of static loads are given in the paper taking into account the limit-stressed state of soils. To achieve these goals, algorithms and calculation programs based on IBM PC have been developed to investigate three different earth dams with their design features, built in various regions of Central Asia; these are the dams with soil cores and the heights: H= 138.5 m, H =87 m and H= 180 m. The results of the numerical implementation of the developed methods are given taking into account the elastic and elastic-plastic laws of strain of the medium.

articleTitle: Algorithms for multithreaded parallel processing of signals on heterogeneous digital telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The research carried out under this work is devoted to the problems of development and implementation of algorithms for multi-threaded parallel signal processing on heterogeneous computing systems, that is, in graphic processors. As a mathematical model for signal processing, the Haar wavelet function is used. In this paper are presented the results of evaluating the performance of a heterogeneous computing system, such as the average signal processing time, the usage of a graphics processor and the device's global memory. The evaluation of the performance obtained with the implementation of the algorithms of wavelet transformation of signal on GPUs.

articleTitle: Upgrading Higher Education through Open Online Courses
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the importance of introducing open online courses into higher education in order to make it more effective and accessible. The stages of emergence and development of online courses among directions of remote education have been studied. Organizational and methodological aspects of development of online education in universities are revealed, barriers and prerequisites of use of online courses in educational process are analyzed. The characteristics of two types of such courses are considered, their advantages and disadvantages are analyzed, as well as possible ways of using already available massive online open courses (MOOC) are highlighted.

articleTitle: Development Of Role Model For Computer System Security
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The present article is devoted to development of a role model with zone differentiation of access. For safety of control and management of access, in this work, it is offered to use the approach based on concepts of "information resource" and "the functional module". By means of functional modules and the set of the universal operations called by the interface realized in them, access to information resources is provided. The interface of access to information resources determines a set universal for this type of resources of operations of access to the information maintenance of a resource, and also operations of its creation, destruction and management of properties, including by attributes of safety. All operations are unambiguously displayed on the relations of access regulated by models of safety of a computer network. Also are described, model of administration of access rights of roles. The choice of this type of a role model is caused by its proximity to real organizational and administrative and organizational and technological schemes at the enterprises and the organizations. In work it is offered functionally - a role model of differentiation of access with the zone policy, allowing to establish the relations of bilateral trust. The mechanism of realization of the developed role model with zone differentiation of access is offered.

articleTitle: Solving the vibration of magnetic elastic plates with sophisticated form
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)

articleTitle: Definition of synchronization processes during parallel signal processing in multicore processors
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article describes how to integrate parallel computing processes into the operational and cache memory of multicore processors and synchronize parallel computing processes. Synchronization is a mechanism that allows you to impose restrictions on the flow order. By synchronizing, the relative order of the threads is regulated and any conflict between the threads that could lead to undesirable program behavior is resolved. It also highlights the following concepts that need to be taken into account when working with memories: Memory problems: bandwidth, working with cache, memory conflicts, cache problems, false separation, memory consistency.

articleTitle: Robust Text Recognition for Uzbek Language in Natural Scene Images
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Text recognition is a challenging and emerging research area in computer vision. The text which is located in images includes semantic data which is practiced in many various applications such as robot navigation, information retrieval of complex images, street signs, beneficial for visually impaired, automatic read the signboard, etc. We propose a text recognition method for Uzbek language using the Tesseract engine. We show that the model can recognize the Uzbek language, including Latin and Cyrillic alphabet text. The experimental results of the proposed method show robust performance than other methods.

articleTitle: Computational algorithm for calculating magnetoelastic flexible plates of complex configuration
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Based on the Hamilton(Lagranj) principle there was developed a nonlinear mathematical model of flexible magnetoelastic plate relative to its displace. There also was developed a computational algorithm to solve considered ploblem using Bubnov-Galerkin, Gauss and iterative numerical methods.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of Atmospheric Pollutants Dispersion Taking Into Account Particles Settling Velocity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the numerical modeling of the process of atmospheric pollutants dispersion taking into account particles settling velocity. A model of the process is described by partial differential equations with corresponding initial and boundary conditions. In deriving the model, the basic laws of hydrodynamics were used as well as a set of parameters that significantly affect the process: weather conditions; atmosphere absorption capacity; particles properties, etc. An equation was developed for calculating the settling velocity of solid spherical particles. For the numerical solution of the problem, the implicit finite-difference scheme in time with the second-order approximation was used.

articleTitle: About of One Methods Synthesis the Structural Protected Computer Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper used the method of synthesis of the structure of a corporate computer network, based on the evaluation of this method are given in the design of security metrics protected corporate network at different levels of the model Open System Interconnection.

articleTitle: Numerical solution to the equation of transfer and diffusion of harmful substances distribution in atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Research, prediction and monitoring of air masses in the atmosphere of industrial regions are described in the paper. A mathematical model, an effective numerical algorithm based on the method of splitting into physical processes and analysis of numerical calculations on a computer are developed.

articleTitle: Mathematical model and numerical algortm to study the process of aerosol particles distribution in the atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A mathematical model for predicting, monitoring and evaluating the ecological state of the atmosphere and underlying surface with passive and active impurities, which take into account the mass, diameter, particle density and the changing velocity of particles in the atmosphere is developed in the paper.To determine the velocities of fine-dispersed particles motion in the atmosphere, a system of nonlinear equations is obtained that takes into account the basic physical and mechanical properties of particles and the air mass velocity in the atmosphere, which play an important role.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling Of Vibrating System N-S Component Parts Which Of That The Mobile Machines For Fast Acting Pneumatic Actuator With Self-Damping
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The influence of the type of movers and external load fluctuations on the dynamic qualities of mobile units is revealed.It is given that it is impossible to fully realize the power of the engine due to the mismatch of the energy capacity of tractor-vehicles. It is proved that without increasing the volume of transported goods not be effectively used in agriculture, because the increase in productivity in transport work is associated with an increase in the speed of the introduction of elastic-damping drives of the driving wheels of the tractor is very relevant. A dynamic mathematical model of the oscillatory system n-x component of mobile machines with self-regulating damping. The model will determine the vertical vibration z and lateral rotation vibration φ, as well as transverse vibration. The use of this model in the design of machines will help to find rational dimensions and optimal parameters of the driving mechanisms.

articleTitle: Model and Algorithms for Distribution of Information Flows in Data Transmission Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article provides information on the development of models and algorithms for information flow distribution in data networks, as well as information on the process of controlling and routing traffic flow in the network. The detailed information about balancing features on network in various metrics and effective ways to prevent overload based on The EIGRP protocol are also given.

articleTitle: Problems of increasing efficiency of NIDS by using implementing methods packet classifications on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)

articleTitle: Probabilistic Approach for System Identification using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper gives a clear understanding of how a system can be modeled in a non-parametric and probabilistic way using machine learning based on historical data with taking into account uncertain noise added to the output of the system. We explained key concepts step by step and end up with a unique algorithm. Moreover, we demonstrated an illustrative example of the proposed algorithm in case of nonlinear dynamic system.

articleTitle: Neuro-fuzzy Adaptive Control system for Discrete Dynamic Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper proposes a methodology for creating an adaptive control system for a discrete dynamic object, containing a compensator and a regulator, made on the basis of the fuzzy Sugeno model and allowing to eliminate the side of disturbances and the regulation error. Synthesis algorithms for parametric and structural identification, which along with the back propagation method of error were used to adapt fuzzy models. The use of an adaptive identifier for a neuro-fuzzy control system of a nonlinear dynamic object is proposed, functioning under conditions of uncertainty changes in internal properties and the external environment. Real-time structural and parametric identification algorithms have been developed, which is a combination of the algorithm for identifying the coefficients of linear equations and the method of the theory of interactive adaptation.

articleTitle: Solution of the multi-criterial routing problem in telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, one of the methods for solving the multi-criteria routing problem in multiservice telecommunication networks is presented. This paper proposes a multi-criteria approach that solves the problem of routing in multiservice communication networks and that takes into account not only the technical requirements for resources but also the economic component. To the restrictions imposed on the route - the throughput and the time delay of data transmission in the channel. This approach allows you to build an optimal route for almost any type of service.

articleTitle: The data structure and information model for the information system of monitoring the educational process in the medical field
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article describes business processes for management of the educational process and organizing data structure of information system for monitoring and educational process of the Institute for Postgraduate Medical Education, maintaining a contingent of professor and student course, identify their assimilation and attendance rates, and providing interactive services.

articleTitle: Security issues in E-Learning system
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: E-Learning consists of main part of education systems. There are a lot of types and systems in this area. The increase in their number is assessed by an increase in demand for security. Therefor in this paper is presented components and given threats by components of information security. In addition, at the end of this work is proposed main information security tools to protect E-Learning systems.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis of the regulatory mechanisms of living systems to identify effective influence points during anomalies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper deals with modeling the regulatory mechanisms of living systems to identify effective regulatory points during anomalies. Computational experiments show that at certain values of internal and external cellular conditions there are exist the following regimes: stationary state, auto-oscillations and chaotic behavior, “black hole” effect, “r-windows”. The results showed that in the anomaly areas (dynamic chaos and “black hole” area), the most optimal “treatment strategy” is the transition to the nearest “r-windows” of irregular oscillations or a sequential transition along the chain from “r-windows” to the region of limit cycles using minimization of irregularity levels and metabolic load.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model Of The Processes Of Step-By-Step Processing Of Organic Waste
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: It is stated in the paper that the key products obtained in a biogas digester from anaerobic processing of agricultural organic waste is biogas, high-quality organic fertilizers and B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> vitamins. A program was compiled and solution was found for the method of menatogenesis mixing in a biogas digester and the operation mechanism of this digester. In addition, information is provided that experiments were conducted with the program in production on biogas devices.

articleTitle: Method of constucting packet filtering rules
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses existing problems and solutions in developing methods and models for packet filtering rules. In addition, an optimal method of constructing filtering rules in accordance with the access restriction policy are developed and two-dimensional solutions for the dynamic routing modeling problem are proposed.

articleTitle: Big data analysis for soil monitoring in Smart farming
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Recently, smart systems are widely used in a different field and that systems contain functions of sensing, actuation, and control in order to describe and analyze a situation, and make decisions based on the available data in a predictive or adaptive manner. In this article, implementation of smart system applications in agriculture, the sensor (TDR) and spatial (GNSS) type of soil moisture measurement, big data analysis in soil monitoring, using Global Land Services for monitoring soil water index changes by geoinformation model of territory are presented.

articleTitle: Technological aspects of modelling and research of smart grid
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper design of communicational devices and approbation of Smart Grid technologies are considered. As well the characteristics of the functional properties of Smart Grid technology are presented. Model of the power system in complex program MATLAB are developed.

articleTitle: Formalization of the business process security
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper considers measures to ensure disaster tolerance of the business: the creation of geographically dispersed data centers, the purchase of “anti-slaughter” (fire-resistant) server rooms or the introduction of uninterruptible power systems. Significant proportion of information leaks from the loss or theft of mobile drives and the most dangerous threats to internal information security are analyzed.

articleTitle: Simulation modeling, analysis and performance assessment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A simulation model allows manufacturers to accurately evaluate the performance of their production systems. The most important contribution to the construction of simulation models of production systems is the behavior of the system, which is modeled on the basis of extensive data on production systems and their elements. However, for production systems outsourced, the data provided by external suppliers to manufacturers is usually limited and insufficient. Therefore, a solution is required to identify and ensure the security of system behavior based on available data. In order to investigate the positive or negative impact of changes in any company, it must evaluate its performance.

articleTitle: Method of analyzing of antivirus errors when audit provides
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper are given mean and types of audit, probabilities of transitions between the functioning states of information of protection tools with discrete work time. Also, in this work are given four types of antivirus errors with possible situations in the performance of means of discrete work time. Performance cases of antivirus software are described in the form of directed Graf. By four types of antivirus errors is calculated average time of operation without breaking, intensity of appearing of error, average time of backup and intensity of backup of error.

articleTitle: Improving the effectiveness of teaching the course “Data structure and algorithms” based on structuration and integration of the discipline
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In didactic, a system of empirical pedagogical principles has long existed, following which, it would seem, you can select, organize and structure the training material, accordingly. But in reality, the structuring of the content of the discipline is in no way connected with the information base of the discipline. Information and computer support, distance learning, automated knowledge control are not provided, since the principles of structuring are very general, thus, need to be improved and made more technologically advanced. In accordance with the developed set of didactic requirements for the structuring of educational materials, a practical structuring of the part “Sorting of numerical arrays” of the course “Data Structure” is considered as a running example in this paper. In the experiments, the pedagogical effectiveness of the developed technologies was experimentally tested and practical instructions for the use of this technology were given to the teachers of higher education.

articleTitle: Analysis of algebraic properties of transformation of O’zDSt 1105:2009 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper investigates the algebraic properties of reflections used in the standard encryption algorithm O'zDSt 1105: 2009.

articleTitle: Algorithm and the Program of Construction of the Fuzzy Logical Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers the algorithm and the program for constructing a fuzzy logic model, since solving the problem of intellectual analysis is characterized by a lack of essential information and data in a linguistic form. In such cases it is advisable to apply theories of fuzzy sets and Z-numbers. On the basis of the constructed algorithm and the developed software package, a number of test model problems of estimation, prediction and classification.

articleTitle: Development of digital economy in Uzbekistan and problems of implementation of ICT in enterprises
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the stages of formation and development of digital economy in Uzbekistan, as well as the problems of implementing information and communication technologies in activities of enterprises in Uzbekistan.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz ISM Radio Bands Utilization in Backhaul IP Microwave Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In preceding few decades there have been an exceptional development and progress in the area of backhaul IP Microwave Wireless communication technology. One of the causes of this rapid growth is the use of Industrial Scientific and Medical (ISM) radio bands often known as free bands for radio transmission and reception. IP Microwave radio links operates in 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Industrial Scientific and Medical (ISM) radio bands. For minimizing operational and capital cost IP Microwave radio links operating in 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Industrial Scientific and Medical (ISM) radio bands are the most viable communication technologies of recent times. As in ISM radio bands operators does not have to purchase a designated frequency channel for radio transmission and reception. This results in spectrum efficiency across the globe as the Microwave band is mostly populated in metropolitan cities around the world. In the first section of this research work authors have evaluate the pros and cons of the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Industrial Scientific and Medical (ISM) radio bands and in second section we have recommended the use of 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Industrial Scientific and Medical (ISM) radio bands depending upon the deployment scenarios and area of interest according to user define applications and minimum bandwidth required for the transmission and reception of delay and jitter free stream of Multimedia traffic.

Author Keywords: Industrial Scientific and Medical (ISM) radio bands

articleTitle: About Organization Of Mobile Communications In Long Car Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The high demand for mobile services observed in recent years poses a challenge for telecom operators to expand service areas not only in populated areas, but also in places with a specific architecture and terrain. These places include car tunnels. In this article, the authors discuss some issues of mobile communications in long car tunnels. The requirements for the characteristics of a mobile communication channel and some expressions for calculating signal levels inside rectangular tunnels are considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of Security Protocols in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Nowadays, Wireless Sensor Networks are being used in area monitoring, health care monitoring, environmental/earth sensing, industrial monitoring and therefore security of these networks is becoming a central concern. Wireless Sensor Networks consists of low power, low-cost smart devices that have limited computing resources against current devices, like personal computer. This paper discusses overall constraints, security requirements, security threats, typical attacks and their defensive techniques or countermeasures relevant to the sensor networks. Besides that, best practical suggestions are given to improve current security mechanisms on Wireless Sensor Network.

articleTitle: Mobile Applications As A Modern Means Of Learning English
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Nowadays information technologies influence on all spheres of human activity that ensure the spread of information flows in society, and form a global information space. So, an integral and important part of the informatization of society is the informatization of education thanks to computers, PDAs tablets or mobile phones. Currently, there are about one and a half billion mobile phones in the world, which is three times more than traditional computers. Mobile phones, smartphones, tablets are becoming a major part of human's digital life. Some of these apps are the mobile version of those websites that provide English learning materials for the students as well as other language learners. This article describes the role of educational mobile applications in learning a foreign language. The author focuses on the didactic characteristics of educational mobile applications and their capabilities.

articleTitle: Choice of optimal options for land use of farms with the application of information technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this work, we have developed and investigated the selection of optimal land use options for farms using information technology that fully and comprehensively takes into account factors and technological conditions and provides a comprehensive solution to the problems of territorial development of farm production.

articleTitle: Constructing a model of the process of receiving and storing oilseeds in oil and fat enterprises through the Petri net
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article builds on a model of the process of receiving and storing oilseeds in oil companies using the Petri net. When constructing the model, technological processes and the state of the process are taken into account. Petri nets are widely used in modeling parallel asynchronous, distributed source systems. In particular, models for rapid decision-making and management in discrete manufacturing processes and processes will be built. The Petri net theory is a mathematical specification of the system and enables to obtain the necessary information from the modeling process by analyzing the structure of the system.

articleTitle: Information systems in water management
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to the analysis and role of modern information and communication technologies and systems in the water sector, and the relevance and necessity of using information systems in water use to improve the ameliorative state of irrigated land is justified, which will solve problems such as improving the system for collecting information means of preparing data oriented to a new information technology, introducing an integrated organization of information flows, reduction of resources for data processing capacity, development of decision-making procedures for the formation of options for the development of water use, etc. The task of the most efficient use of water resources and improvement of land ameliorative condition is to obtain the maximum amount of products at lower cost. The assessment of water use efficiency is made not by their value, but by the effect obtained by the water consumer.

articleTitle: Neural identification of a dynamic model of a technological process
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of determining the rational mode of the technological process on the basis of a fuzzy production model is considered, as well as the task of automatically controlling the main parameters of the oil cracking process taking into account its dynamic characteristics using the error back propagation algorithm to adapt a multidimensional fuzzy controller.

articleTitle: Distribution Model Of Heterogeneous Flow In A Software-Defined Multiservice Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: It is proposed that packets of heterogeneous traffic are transported at the multiservice network transport level to organize on the basis of a software-configured network, the expediency of organizing the transmission of packets of heterogeneous traffic is not justified on one, but on different virtual channels.

articleTitle: Hybrid Automaton Implementation For Intelligent Agents’ Behavior Modelling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: It is predicted that the future of our world might be considered as an urban future, and this future should be happy, or, at least, livable. To describe ways and conditions for creating this future, the “smart city” concept has been worked out. “Smart city” in this concept is under consideration as a cyber-physical system. Digital twins have become the main elements of these systems, while computer simulation is to be the main technology for these systems investigation. In this paper, the process of a hybrid (continuous-discrete) automaton implementation for the aim of intelligent agents' behavior modelling is under discussion.

articleTitle: Modeling Of Geophysical Signals Based On The Secondorder Local Interpolication Splay-Function
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to modeling geophysical signals based on secondary interpolation spline function. The use of second-order local interpolation spline functions for the construction of mathematical models for digital processing and recovery of various geophysical signals is relevant today. As an example, preliminary experimental data of geophysical signals were obtained and based on this data, a second-order local interpolation cubic spline model was constructed. A geophysical signal interpolation process was performed using a built-in local interpolation cubic spline model.

articleTitle: Sustainable Algorithms for Assessing the Condition of Objects Based on the Kinematic Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The stable algorithms for estimating the state of objects in the kinematic formulation based on the concepts of the principle of iterative regularization are given. To solve the problem under consideration, an iterated version of the regularization method is used. A.N.Tikhonov. It is shown that the regularization parameter in the problem in question is advisable to determine on the basis of a posteriori methods. Using the obtained results allows you to synthesize robust algorithms for processing measurements without using information about the dynamics of an object and adaptively choose one or another mathematical tool depending on the degree of a priori information about the object, which is especially important when synthesizing information collection and processing systems.

articleTitle: Mathematical and software of fractal structures from combinatorial numbers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper deals with the issues related to the concept of arithmetic structures and combinatorial numbers. We consider the Pascal triangle and binomial coefficients, as well as generalized Pascal triangles and generalized binomial coefficients

articleTitle: Creating a Robust ICT Base for the Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Thanks to the development of information and communication technologies, the connotation of the digital divide has evolved constantly. Currently, we are opening and entering the new era of “ Digital Economy” and newest information technologies including Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Internet of Things, Big Data have been widely enhanced and implemented. Such developments accelerate the gap between developed and developing economies, which eventually attracts more attention. In this article current activities of Uzbekistan in the sphere of digital economy are analyzed and some suggestions related to problems arouse are provided.

articleTitle: The formation of the structure of a multiservice network based on communication equipment from different manufacturers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the formation of the MSS structure, the article proposes to use switching equipment of different manufacturers, the effectiveness of this approach is shown by simulation based on the OPNET Modeler system version 14.5. Routers with various protocols were investigated and an analysis was made of the distribution of the delay time and the effect of the functioning of the protocols on the throughput of the main protocols benveen the routers.

articleTitle: Development of medical information systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The fuzzy integral of a function with a fuzzy measure is a general estimate in the form of a nonlinear convolution of particular estimates of information elements, and the possibility of interconnection of information elements is not excluded. Here is an approach that al-lows the expert to best formalize his fuzzy ideas, trans-forming the language of words into a language of quantitative estimates.

articleTitle: Ways To Develop Innovative Processes In Grain Production
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the development of innovative processes in grain production. It has been shown that grain production at all times has been and remains the main branch of agriculture, providing the country's population needs for bread products and exerting influence on the development of animal husbandry and other sectors of the agri-food complex, the state of its economy and sustainable development. Grain farming is presented as a static multifunctional and system-forming industry, which decisively forms the basis for the effective functioning of the entire agro-industrial complex. The development of domestic grain production, the increase in its competitiveness and efficiency, due to the increased need to increase production efficiency based on the development of the achievements of the scientific and technological process, was noted.

Author Keywords: the country’s population’s need for bread products
impact on livestock and other sectors of the agro-industrial complex
the use of scientific and technological progress

articleTitle: Selecting suitable deep learning network for face recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper is given problems in face recognition methods and algorithms, ways of improving of recognition accuracy and decreasing errors. There are false acceptance and rejection errors in face recognition and these errors are decreased by normalization method when detected occlusion faces. For increasing face recognition accuracy and speed is proposed combining of deep learning networks and optimization of filter size.

articleTitle: Sustainable Service-Oriented Architecture for Smart City Development
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Nowadays, smart cities are becoming very popular and serve to increase the life qualities of citizens. In the framework of smart cities, software platforms and applications are meant to provide different services to citizens, and to increase efficiency in government and non-government services in daily lives of people. The main driver of smart cities are software platforms and applications. Thus, all citizen services are provided by software applications and platforms consisting of various government and non-government services. Development, maintenance and sustainability of such large software applications is a challenge which requires well-established and sustainable software architectures. This paper addresses to the problem of sustainable software architectures for sustainable smart city application development as its central focus.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Processes Occuring On Interface Boundaries
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper the singularities of electromagnetic wave propagation at their dropping on the boundary of media are considered. Also, the research results of reflectivity coefficients for some materials are given.

articleTitle: Hardware-software complex detect smoke and fire from video images
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article describes the hardware-software complex for the recognition of smoke and fire from CCTV cameras. The article is conventionally divided into two parts in the first part of the article devoted to hardware devices: characteristics and advantages of the computing node of the module. The second part of the article is devoted to the software. In this paper, we used method segmentation for the HSV color space and the detection method based on the YOLOV2 (You Only Look Once) algorithm for smoke and fire recognition.

articleTitle: Change of hydrological regime of foothill small rivers of Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article analyzes water resources and their changes in the hydrological regime of the foothill small rivers Govasay and Podshaotasay (Namangan region, Uzbekistan). The required volumes of water for irrigation of adjoining lands and actually expected volumes of water were estimated based on data for the last 10 years.

articleTitle: Towards Integrated IoT-Languages
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Internet of things(IoT) is a nascent technology that envisages connecting everything to the Internet and intends to improve people's lives by providing intelligent services ubiquitously. As IoT comprises heterogeneous technology stack it is difficult for developers to describe IoT components for further exploiting on IoT development activities. Model-driven engineering posses required capabilities to describe heterogeneous IoT components, separate stakeholders' concerns and one of the best candidates to handle the IoT development challenges.Therefore, there is a need to develop a set of languages, which models IoT systems from different perspectives and keep those models consistent. This paper intends to describe an integrated multi-viewpoint approach to develop IoT systems.

articleTitle: Providing resources in Fog Computing infrastructure: considerations on performance requirements
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Fog Computing, as evolving paradigm in modern application scenarios, came to the arena as Cloud Computing developments successor, providing elastic resources and services to end users at the edge of network, while cloud computing are more about providing resources distributed in the core network. Fog computing is able to provide better Quality of Service in terms of delay, power consumption, reduced data traffic over the global network etc. The main feature of Fog computing is its ability to support applications which require low latency, location awareness, and mobility. This paper discusses various aspects of issues may be encountered when designing and implementing fog computing systems. With the purpose of the estimation of the capabilities of Fog Computing, the experimental network implementing the major components has been investigated, with defining the prerequisites for modeling Fog Computing architecture as well as management issues to be considered in the context of fog computing.

articleTitle: Analysis of the routing methods and Internet models for IoT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze different routing protocols based on TCP/IP model and using NS-3 simulation environment made a comparison, based on the performance metrics like packet delivery ratio, throughput in different kind of network conditions: different number of static and mobile nodes, and different power. By analyzing issues of protocols, we found out that problems are the same and they are because of the model TCP/IP, which was not developed for the Internet in today and for Internet of things. As a solution for this problem, we propose to use NDN model and show its advantages in Internet of things.

articleTitle: Formation of Relational Structures of Information Identification Models for Insecta Orthoptera Bioobject
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We consider the integration of information technology with biology, enabling specialists to further explore the subject area. The object of the research is the identification of the information structure and parameters of the Insects Orthoptera of Uzbekistan. For this purpose, an information identification software package has been created and an analysis has been carried out of the diversity of orthoptera, which have a specific internal structure and, accordingly, a formed structure of a relational database of the form Insecta Orthoptera.

articleTitle: A Novel Reputation Model for Trusted Path Selection in the OLSR Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Models based on the concept of trust and reputation are widely used for securing routing protocols in self-organizing networks. The paper considers existing approaches to secure the OLSR routing protocol and identifies their drawbacks. Based on the existing approaches, we proposed a new Boolean-valued reputation model, a trust-based routing metric and an algorithm for finding the most trusted paths from a single source to all destinations. The proposed model was implemented as an extension of the OLSR routing protocol in ns-3 network simulator. Some results of simulation tests are also presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Analysis Of The Relationship Between The Indicators Of Controllability And Reliability Characteristics Of Data Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article deals with the influence of indicators of controllability on the reliability characteristics of data transmission systems (DSS). The analysis of the impact of the volume of built-in controls on the reliability and reliability of data transmission systems. The obtained results make it possible to assess the indicators of controllability at the design stage of data transmission systems.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Adaptive Control Systems of a Multidimensional Discrete Dynamic Object with a Forecasting Models
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the possibility of creating a system of automatic control of a dynamic object, that has the properties of adaptation and changes in the system parameters. A two-level scheme of synthesis of control actions taking into account the predicted models of the control object is proposed. An algorithm is developed for calculating the values of controlled actions, which allows the criterion of optimality to be minimized for the number of control cycles to be met.

articleTitle: Automatic diffusion mixing system for watering in regions with high water sales
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article devoted to combined construction of two filtration systems of salt water in one pump unit. The article considers not only constructive solutions, but also issues of automatic control of the technological process.The article has results of experimental stand, dates, particular qualities of sensor and distance control of SIM900D.

articleTitle: Efficient Portfolios Computed via Moment-Based Bounding-approximations: Part I - EB
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We develop and analyze mean-variance efficient portfolios. Each portfolio comes as a solution of an optimization problem, which approximates the expected value of a utility function. The approximation is an upper bound on the expected value of the utility function. The bound is based on the first two probability moments and cross-moments of the portfolio”s random return. We prove that the optimal solution of the approximate optimization problem yields a mean-variance efficient portfolio. We illustrate how to use the resulting portfolio in practice by designing a daily trading strategy with stocks traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). The approximate optimization model is solved once every day. Out-of-sample numerical results are presented for 27 years of daily trading for 24 stocks from NYSE.

articleTitle: Modeling, Analysis and Performance Evaluations of Phantom Positioning by Using kV X-ray Imaging, CBCT, and IR Camera
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article, we performed the positioning modeling of several phantoms on the VERO radiation device. We used different positioning methods to position several phantoms and checking functionality. As reference phantom, we used pelvic phantom to check the accuracy of the registration algorithm in terms of using bony anatomy information or artificial markers positions. All data and images which were used in this article were taken by the linear accelerator (Linac) of the University Clinic of Erlangen.

articleTitle: Algorithm For The Control Of Receivables In The Declaration Of Foreign Trade Goods In Real Time
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The task of modeling the process of customs clearance of goods of foreign trade is considered. One of the priority tasks of the customs authorities is the automation of the process of controlling receivables of foreign trade participants in conditions of remote declaration of goods. In the course of making decisions on the customs clearance of goods, there is a problem associated with determining the monitoring criteria for the receivables of foreign trade participants. The proposed method for calculating receivables allows you to develop an algorithm for controlling it when declaring foreign trade goods in real time.

Author Keywords: multidimensional information matrix of the cargo customs declaration
criteria and logic control algorithm for receivables

articleTitle: Data Transmission Method on the Basis of Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper considers the issues of organizing the reliable data transmission over non-stationary discrete communication channels. An analysis of existing data transmission systems with feedback is carried out, with defining the shortcomings of existing mechanisms for determining the optimal data block length in data transmission systems with feedback. Data transmission method is developed based on reinforcement learning.

Author Keywords: optimal length of the data block

articleTitle: Information model and criteria for the completeness of certification of foreign trade goods of the Single Window customs information system of the Republic of Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of developing the national customs system “Single Window” of the Republic of Uzbekistan to automate the process of certification of foreign trade goods is considered. In the process of decisions on customs clearance of goods, there is a problem of ensuring the reliability of these decisions related to the application of the criterion of completeness of certification of goods. The proposed methodology for information modeling of the requirements of customs legislation allows us to develop criteria for ensuring the completeness of certification of foreign trade goods.

Author Keywords: criteria for the completeness of certification of goods

articleTitle: Modeling dynamic operation of mechanisms in Autodesk Inventor Professional 11
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The effectiveness of various graphic programs using Autodesk Inventor Professional 11 is described in the paper. The technological and demonstration platform is assembled into a single software package, linked to the concept of the project. The centralized use of this platform in its final form and in the process of creating and promoting software allows avoiding additional costs for software and hardware.

articleTitle: VR as a method and educational tool in the field of higher education of the Republic of Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper presents the development trends of the modern higher education system of the Republic of Uzbekistan, the concept of the use of virtual reality in the education system, the comparative characteristics of the classical higher education system with the education system using virtual reality, which leads to greater efficiency at low cost. The development of a virtual laboratory, made at the Tashkent University of Information Technologies, on the Unity platform using the example of Arduino Uno, is given.

articleTitle: The Use Of Technology In Corpus Linguistics
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Corpus linguistics can be termed as the study of language founded on evidence derived from corpora. While “corpora” is a general word defining the use of corpus software in the extraction of patterns derived from corpus. It revolves around unfolding occurrences of a phrase or word within the corpus as well as accounting on its occurrence frequency in comparison to others. This paper explores the application of technological advances within corpus linguistics as a new avenue within research and pedagogy. There have been a couple of studies that was captured and utilized methodologies and insights within the subject which at the end have revived theoretical intelligence of corpus within the writing field. However, many gaps have been left unserved mostly on its application on the teaching area as well as its feasibility. To this end, it's of consensus that the modern world demands an innovative industry in all areas of concern and thus makes this rationale more researchable. This is a qualitative research design that involves a vast array of techniques that captures: open-ended interviews, observations and a grounded survey meant to expound on this topic in order to add more literature on linguistics.

articleTitle: Efficiency Estimation of the Inter-Frame Coding of Modern Video Codecs
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article an experimental efficiency estimation of inter-frame compression for video streams in modern video codecs, operating in such standard, like MPEG-4- XviD, H.264 and, H.265 is provided. Also the experimental results of image compression based on the motion compensation of video objects in the processing of videos with local, global and combined movement are presented.

articleTitle: The study of the influence of the gamma function on the flutter velocity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Most of the problems of hereditarily deformable systems, mathematically modeled by means of linear weakly singular integro-differential equations, are not linear in the strict approach. Linearization of such problems (both geometrically and physically, as well as aerodynamically) is performed solely in order to avoid mathematical difficulties associated with solving nonlinear integral and integro-differential equations. In this article, the aerodynamic profile of the ”hereditarily deformed” wing is considered in a steady flow of gas with different velocities and we investigate the parameters due to the dynamics of the process.

articleTitle: An application of RNN to the inverse-QSAR problem
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: RNN model was used in solution of inverse QSAR problem. Authors demonstrate an efficient approach in generating new molecules de nova with desired Activity values. They used SMILES representations of given set and trained a network capable of producing new series of symbols.

articleTitle: Processing Color Images, Brightness and Color Conversion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The use of color in image processing is due to two main reasons. Firstly, color is an important feature that often facilitates recognition and selection of an object in an image. Secondly, a person is able to distinguish between thousands of different shades of color and only about two dozen shades of gray. The second circumstance is especially important when visual (that is, performed directly by man) image analysis.Processing of color images can divided into two main areas: image processing in natural colors and image processing in pseudo-colors. In the first case, the images in question are usually formed by color image recording devices, such as a color television camera or a color scanner.
