In the second case, the task is to assign colors to some intensity values of a monochrome signal or to some ranges of changes in its intensity. Until relatively recently, digital processing of color images was carried out mostly at the level of pseudo colors. Over the past decade, however, color input devices and color image processing hardware have become quite affordable. As a result, natural image processing technology currently used in a wide range of applications, including publishing systems, visualization systems, and the Internet. It will be clear from the subsequent discussions that some halftone processing techniques developed in previous chapters are directly applicable to color images. Other methods should be reformulated and consistent with the properties of the color space, which constructed later in this chapter. The methods described in this chapter are far from exhaustive; they illustrate a variety of techniques applicable to color image processing.

Author Keywords: modeling of image processing processing color images

articleTitle: Reliability of Open Optical Transmission Systems in the Backbone Core Cellular Networks of Cellular Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The calculation of the probability of failure-free communication based on the law of the probability distribution of the meteorological visibility range, the data obtained as a result of statistical analysis of the ITM Meteoinfo system in Tashkent are given. The expediency of using atmospheric optical transmission systems (AOTS) in the backbone core cellular networks is shown, and when backing up with a parallel radio line operating in the millimeter wave range, practically any backbone communication channels.

articleTitle: Development of a method to build Fiber Bragg grating-based sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the paper authors analyze the use of optical fiber to transmit data in telecommunication systems, the use of optical fiber in the rapidly growing field of fiber optic sensors based on the creation and functioning of the so-called Bragg gratings, describe the results of the experiment of measuring elongation and deformation when changing annealing parameters. The elongation of the sample was calculated using the finite (FEM) and boundary element method (BEM) in the mathematical model. The results of the experiment are shown - the effect of the increase in temperature at the Bragg grating on the wavelength, refractive index and spectral reflection characteristics.

articleTitle: Expression Of Emotive Words In The Language And Speech
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article represents the different emotive words and emotions expressing in the language and speech. They activate and organize the perception, thinking and aspirations of a person. Emotions are a powerful lever helping to open the curtain on the incomprehensible, broaden horizons, acquire new skills, abilities, and knowledge. Words are in continuous connection with our intellectual and emotional life. The subject - logical meaning of each word is surrounded by a special expressive atmosphere, which varies depending on the context.

articleTitle: Projecting Parametres Trade Electronic Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: this article discusses the features and trends of process of development and creation of a multi-functional electronic trading platform is aimed at efficient and profitable interaction of suppliers and buyers. Interaction takes place through electronic communication systems, so it is always operative and relevant. Electronic trading platform is a complex of information and modern technical solutions. There are several types of electronic trading platforms - for commercial customers, for placing government orders. The sites on which electronic transactions are performed by commercial customers are divided into specialized and multi-profile. Users, participants of the sites, held auctions and trades themselves can decide on which of the sites it is more convenient and profitable to work with. In addition, on a multiprofile resource the customer can act as a supplier, the seller - this is dependent on the scope of his activities, on the possibilities.

articleTitle: Game theory and its application in agriculture (greenhouse complexes)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This work is devoted to the analysis of the effectiveness of the application of game theory in the agricultural industry by the example of growing vegetables in greenhouses and in open ground.

articleTitle: Analysis of Projecting the Electronic Trading System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the features and trends of process of development and creation of a multi-functional electronic trading platform is aimed at efficient and profitable interaction of suppliers and buyers. Interaction takes place through electronic communication systems, so it is always operative and relevant. Electronic trading platform is a complex of information and modern technical solutions. There are several types of electronic trading platforms - for commercial customers, for placing government orders. The sites on which electronic transactions are performed by commercial customers are divided into specialized and multi-profile. Users, participants of the sites, held auctions and trades themselves can decide on which of the sites it is more convenient and profitable to work with. In addition, on a multiprofile resource the customer can act as a supplier, the seller - this is dependent on the scope of his activities, on the possibilities.

articleTitle: Algorithm for calculating the processes of salt transfer in soils on reclaimed lands
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers a mathematical model of salt transfer in which the total porosity of the soil is the fraction of “through” and “dead-end” pores with the corresponding concentration. To solve this problem, an effective numerical algorithm based on the use of quadrature formulas in combination with the differential sweep method has been developed.

articleTitle: Digital Control Model of Technological Process of the Yellow Phosphorus Sublimation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Creation of digital control of technological and production process of obtaining yellow phosphorus remains an urgent task of our time. The main unit of production of yellow phosphorus - closed ore-thermal furnace is controlled. A two-level control system for yellow phosphorus production is presented. The peculiarity of this work is to take into account the human factor (LPR), as well as a number of properties of the process control system - consistency, stochasticity, fuzzy logic.

articleTitle: Digital Signal Processing Based On Spline Functions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The development of the modern world's information and communication technologies and their implementation in various industries are important, are essential to the creation of parallel algorithms for solving problems of the recovery and digital signal processing, on the basis of the treatment processes a multi-core architecture and the search for optimal solutions. The current stages of development of the structure of machines, complexes and systems installed at facilities that are part of the structure of devices specialized for conducting scientific research or located on rolling stock are characterized by on-line analysis of complex processes and fields and increased demands on the speed of processing large amounts of data in real time. Particular attention is paid to the development of methods for solving problems of image and signal processing by using modern methods, algorithms and structural tools, architecture of computing and software. In that work the result of the study of methods of approximation of functions and functional dependencies obtained in the course of experiments for the selected class of signals improved method of spline functions on the basis of analytical analysis, parallel algorithms for digital signal processing have been developed, efficient algorithms have been developed for digital processing of vibrio signals in multi-core processors based on cubic and bi cubic basis splines.

articleTitle: Development Of Creativity Of Learners In The Courses Of Advanced Training And Retraining Of Pedagogical Staff In The Process Of Studying The Course "Innovative Educational Technology"
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article devoted to the methodology for the development of creative learning of higher educational institutions' teachers in advanced training courses and retraining of pedagogical staff in the areas of computer science, mathematics and physics. The course “Innovative educational technologies” includes concepts as creativity, creative learning, organizational and pedagogical conditions of creative learning, and stages of development of creativity of pedagogical staff.

articleTitle: Efficiency Estimation Of Image Resizing Based On Interpolating Transformations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article efficiency estimation of digital images resizing (dimensional changing) using various interpolators, such as Bicubic, B-Spline (B-Spline), Mitchell (Mitchell), Lanczos (Lanczos) is provided. Also the experimental results of quality changing after image reduction and restoration are presented.

articleTitle: The model of forming the structure of the “cloud” data center
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article combining previously developed methods, models and algorithms, a computational experiment on the formation of the structure of a cloud data center was conducted and its results are presented. The efficiency of the data center is proposed to be evaluated by profit, obtained by servicing user requests. It is proposed to take into account not only processor time, but also the transmission time of requests during transportation over a network based on the ideology of a software-defined networking.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of static characteristics of electromagnetic current converter to detect current asymmetry of the traction power supply system
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the paper proposes a design of a device for converting current into voltage with advanced functionality, designed to detect asymmetry of three-phase currents in both DC and AC circuits. Made theoretical investigations and mathematical model of static characteristics of the converter from changes in the magnetization curve of the magnetic material under the interaction of two fields generated by modulating current flowing in the modulation coil and an alternating magnetic field with a strength and created during the flow of DC buses DC field strength and shown that the nonlinearity of the dependence really is a principal factor responsible for the emergence of E.M.F., carrier information about the converted direct current.

articleTitle: A model of the regulatory mechanisms of liver cells in hepatitis B viruses (HBV) and its latent form
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Based on the methodology of mathematical modeling of the regulatory mechanisms of biosystems, mathematical and computer models developed to study the functioning of the regulatory mechanisms of liver cells in hepatitis B viruses and its latent forms. Some of the results and their analysis obtained from the computational experiments are presents.

articleTitle: The Applicability of Corpus Linguistics in the Field of Linguistics
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Corpus Linguistics refers to an enormous collection of text through which use of language or corpus of a particular variety is represented. The importance of reviewing corpus linguistics and its principle from a linguistic perspective should be documented. Thus, this paper aims at examining the plausibility of corpus linguistics' objectives and methodologies in context of basic tenets related to linguistics. The doctrines about the data nature and usage for linguistic analysis will also be used to determine how corpus linguistics methods stand up to them. This paper also encompasses a discussion regarding the issue of representativeness in light of Douglas Biber's influential research paper “Representativeness in Corpus Design”.

articleTitle: Monitoring Railway Turnout using its Moving Traces
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Turnouts (switches/points) are one of the most crucial and vulnerable part of the railway infrastructure. Several factors such as high frequency use, heavy freight and high-speed traffic provoke the turnouts to lead its alignment. The alignment change shall be in disastrous consequences. The turnout point movement, of which traces represent as oblique lines in time to moving distance, can inform its healthy state. In this paper, we tried to identify turnout health whether it is normal or not, by using the oblique line characteristics.

articleTitle: The Research Of Reliability Indicators Transport Systems Multi - Service Network Based Fuzzy Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article proposes a method for studying reliability indicators of the MSN transport system (TS) based on the theory of fuzzy sets, specifies random factors affecting the reliability indicators of the MSN TS and the decisions made to eliminate them, describes the search for a variant that ensures stable operation of the TS MSN at minimal cost.

Author Keywords: on the analysis of the load of equipment at each level

articleTitle: Smart School In Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This research was aimed at studying the ICT integration in everyday life of one Iranian smart school. The model, which is used, considers the school as a whole and as a system. The research approach is qualitative. The research data was gathered by 3 months observation and interviews with teachers and students. The model of the examination has several elements including: ICT included in strategic planning, teaching and learning methods - participation for empowerment, flexibility of curriculum, investments in communication, leadership and management and teaching staff's capacity and commitment. According to research findings, ICT is not in the everyday life the school.

Index Terms: Information And Communication Technology In Education

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of regulatory mechanisms of cardiological pathologies in the tumor process
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article considers mathematical modeling of regulatory mechanisms of the cardiovascular system, based on the method of functional differential equations of cardiac regulation and equations for the quantitative description of blood movement in vessels and tissues using the reduced Navier-Stokes equations and the equations of active and passive transfers in normal and in case of tumor processes in human organs. The results of computational experiments showed the presence of five areas of functioning: a trivial attractor, stationary mode, stable oscillations with a constant period, irregular oscillations (a risk zone for life-threatening arrhythmias during chemical and radiation therapy) and a “black hole” (sudden cardiac death during antitumor treatment).

articleTitle: A new way to distribute secret encryption keys
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: this article describes a new method for distributing secret encryption keys, in which processes use algebra with a parameter, the secrecy of which provides increased durability of the key.

articleTitle: U-Net Architecture Application to Nuclei Cell Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper U-Net neural network architecture and its' variations for biomedical image processing is described. The application of the U-Net to the task of nuclei cell detection in particular is analyzed. The features and difficulties of the task are addressed. Several techniques to improve training and performance of the network are studied and, as a result, the model with specific parameters for the task of nuclei cell detection is proposed.

articleTitle: Modeling the problem of horizontal drainage on irrigated lands
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the calculation of drainage and its parameters using a mathematical model. Drainage on irrigated land is a complex of hydraulic structures designed to collect and drain groundwater. The main parameters of horizontal drainage are its depth and the distance between drains. A program has been created to calculate the depth of horizontal drainage and the distance between drains.

articleTitle: Simulation of electrical resistivity tomography curves in a three-dimensional medium with a ground surface relief and immersed inhomogeneity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper is devoted to simulation direct current electrical prospecting curves for a 3D medium with a ground surface relief and with immersed inhomogeneity. This paper presents a mathematical model, a numerical method for solving the direct problem of electrical resistivity tomography using the method of integral equations, the test results of this algorithm and the numerical simulation results of the apparent resistivity curves to take into account and evaluate the influence of the ground surface relief. The test results of this algorithm showed the accuracy of taking into account the shape of the relief, efficiency and cost-effectiveness in using the computer resources.

articleTitle: The role of ICT and the problems of organizing Distance education in Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Nowadays, distance education is a form of education, in which the best traditional and innovative methods, means and forms of learning based on computer and telecommunication technologies are used in educational process. The relationship between work and life-long learning is inseparable. Professional knowledge becomes out of date very quickly, so its regular improvement is necessary. Today the world telecommunication infrastructure provides the possibility of creating systems of mass ongoing self-education, universal exchange of information regardless of time and space zones.Today, the educational system of the Republic of Uzbekistan adapts the rich advanced world experience in teaching and modern pedagogical and information technologies. However, in higher education system, due to the number of obstacles, this adaptation goes slowly. The main problem of distance education development is the creation of new methods and learning technologies that correspond to the telecommunication environment of communication. The introduction of distance education will bring to Uzbekistan a rapid integration into the world economic educational and information space.

articleTitle: Model And Algorithm For Solving One-Dimensional Two-Phase Of Filtration Task
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper presents the mathematical model of a two-phase one-dimensional filtration with allowance for capillary forces is presented. The computational algorithm and programs for the mathematical model are created. The reliability of the developed algorithm was verified by a test case.

articleTitle: The probability model of railway transport system activity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article described the probability model of railway transport system. Developed a mathematical model, which illustrates the state of affairs and claims that the Markov process are accompanied by a separate number of cases.

articleTitle: Review of Analysis on IoT Components, Devices and Layers Security
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoTs) continues to connect multifarious devices with the Internet and show exponential growth. Unhindered information exchange between these devices is critical for their proper functionality. With interconnectedness come the problems of ensuring security and protection from attacks. This review evaluates IoT attacks and security vulnerabilities on the hardware components and the architectural layers of the devices. Open areas for further research are identified to help isolate specific sections.

articleTitle: Transport System Reliability Study Multi-Service Network Based On Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article develops an algorithm that allows to demonstrate the reliability indicators of dos-tup levels and multiservice transport based on simulation. The target function was to use the minimum criterion for the amount allocated to improve the reliability of costs and cost-effectiveness arising from residual unreliability.

articleTitle: Comparison of the molecular descriptors efficiency in modeling the structure-activity relationship
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to test the combination of various sets of descriptors in the framework of kNN-QSAR method, including the SiRMS descriptors, which allow interpreting the constructed model. An example of case study and interpretation is shown based on the set, that is consist of 90 nitroaromatic compounds tested for in vivo toxicity. Firstly, was investigated different sets of descriptors generated by the Rcdk package, from which the Simulated Annealing (SA) procedure selects different sets of descriptors, which then utilized to develop regression models. Then the other descriptor generation systems - Dragon 6.0 and SIRMS were used. Important conclusion of this study is that once again confirmed the need to select the appropriate set of descriptors in each particular case, which was many times emphasized by other authors. In addition, this work gives an example of proper interpretation of the constructed models.

articleTitle: To Improve The Content Of Methodical Preparation Of Future Teachers Of Informatics On The Basis Of Web-Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We review the new content of the course “Methods of teaching Informatics”, which is improved by including topics related to the didactic capabilities of modern Web-technologies in this paper. In the course of the study, the basic competencies for the use of Web technologies in students of pedagogical higher educational institutions are determined. 179 students from Tashkent state pedagogical University (TSPU), Jizzakh pedagogical Institute (DSPI) and Kokand pedagogical Institute (KPI) were involved as an experimental platform. The results of experimental work analyzed on the basis of student's t-test showed the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Web Quest as a Method Formation Teacher’s Scientific and Methodological Activity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article reveals the essence and content of the concept of “scientific and methodological web-activity as well as the methodology for the formation of scientific and methodological web-activity for students of higher educational institutions of pedagogical areas of education based on the use of research web-quests of a pedagogical nature. Tashkent University of Information Technologies, Karakalpak State University and Navoi State Pedagogical Institute with a sample of 271 students were selected as an experimental site. The experimental results analyzed on the basis of student t-test showed the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Innovative approaches in reshaping activities of the Department “Information and Library Systems”
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the specific use of foreign languages in the activities of the department “Information and Library Systems” of the Tashkent University of Information Technologies, as well as the introduction in a curriculum a new special subjects and teaching them in English.

Author Keywords: methodology of teaching information and library disciplines

articleTitle: Animal Habit Monitoring System on the Road side to avoid animal collisions with Support Vector Machine Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Collisions between vehicle and animal still do not lose its significance in terms of traffic safety. In spite of, a lot measures to reduce the conflict have been established around the world it still hazardous for both of wildlife and people. In that case for remaining traffic safety we need advanced technology used control system. LDM (Local Dynamic Map) is a data store standardized by European Telecommunications Standards Institute, utilized for displaying location and status of road users on a dynamic map. Machine learning SVM (Support Vector Machine) model, which is used for both regression and classification problems, the objective of algorithm finding hyperplane to classify the data points in N-dimensional space. The main purpose of this research is to decrease the collisions between wildlife-vehicles by performing machine learning SVM predictions in LDM based database environment.

articleTitle: Infographics Application for Visualization of E-Sports Gaming Activity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: After the inclusion of e-sports disciplines in a number of sporting events, betting companies began to actively interact with these sports. There was a need to collect and analyze information in a completely new direction, a feature of which is a large amount of information and a huge audience. The developed system for collecting statistics and subsequent analysis of e-sports events using the example of the “Dota 2” e-sports discipline. The system is designed for both players and betting organizations and people betting on upcoming matches. The paper analyzes data visualization methods. Information is presented in the most ergonomic form, like linear diagrams.

articleTitle: IMRT Verification, Analysis and Performance Evaluations: Modeling of Dose Delivery by Shifting MLC Angel and Phantom Position
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In modern radiology treatment workflow, verification is a critical process for determining the validity of specific treatment planning. In this article, we verified a treatment plan by modeling of dose delivery by shifting MLC angel and phantom position. The study result shows that any error during the verification process such as an error in the MLC angle or the phantom positioning may lead to different passing rate and refuse a plan, which it is correct originally.

articleTitle: Power Amplifier With Injection-Voltaic Transistor With Quiescent Current Stabilization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Possibility of use of the bipolar transistor working in injection-voltaic a mode, as the operated generator of a stable current is investigated. It is created three-structural injection-voltaic the transistor, simultaneously strengthening and high-current resistance (a mode of the generator of a current). It is developed operated high-current generator on the bipolar transistor. The scheme of the power amplifier with no need of initial or subsequent adjustments of quiescent current, resistant to temperature variations, supply voltage variations and the scatter of parameters of transistors.

Author Keywords: power amplifiers with a predetermined quiescent current
multistage homo and geterocomposite Darlington and Sziklai transistors
methods of stabilization of output stages radio devices

articleTitle: IT Team Building for Experiential Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: New times demand new educational paradigm for growing up professionals. CDIO Initiative with experiential learning as its pedagogical foundation has proposed main standards for engineering education. The team project could become one of the main forms of the experiential learning. In this case, building an effective team might be considered as a vital factor for project and, consequently, educational process success. In this materials, main approaches and models for effective team building are under discussion. Several practical advices for supporting process of division a student group into teams for carrying out IT projects are delivered.

articleTitle: Support systems for monetary circulation decision-making
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problems of monetary circulation regulation are considered in the paper. A scheme is proposed for modeling the regulation process of monetary circulation. A software package has been developed for processing the knowledge and opinions of experts by the method of hierarchy analysis and by reducing numerical machine experiments to econometric models of monetary circulation. Examples of a result fragment of processing the expert opinions are given.

articleTitle: Curriculum Development as a Task of Optimizing the Educational Process in Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses a software product for automatic scheduling for a higher educational institution (in particular, for TUIT). The program was written using an algorithm for assessing the freedom of location of each lesson in the schedule. The application provides the following functionality: adding, editing, deleting and working with the database, as well as using it to schedule both full-time and part-time courses.

articleTitle: Virtual Keyboard and Fingers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of data entry in mobile devices is considered. The shortcomings of virtual projected keyboards are analyzed. The new input technology called VKF (Virtual Keyboard and Fingers) is offered. It is shown that VKF is more convenient not only in comparison with projected virtual keyboards, but also with data entry methods including use of on-screen keyboards.

articleTitle: Electronic invoice system database architecture issues and the possible solutions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper elucidates electronic invoice system's database architecture requirements and its building issues that one may encounter. Enumerated requirements and issues were taken into consideration and it is suggested to use three types of DB in the system. NoSQL model of database for its numbers of advantages is recommended for the information reused by users to store and querying them. The database is able to split database loadequally with the help of horizontal sharding. Making partition numbers equal to the number which has common divisors as much as possible will let splitting load amount equally among possible additional infrastructure. A special approach is required to each element of system to perfectly create architecture of the information system's database.

articleTitle: Data transferring with encryption algorithms in multi- platform information system climate control of buildings
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This publication describes the technology and development of encryption and decryption keys generated to increase their cryptographic stability, providing secure data and key transmission over an open communication channel for reliable data transmission in a multi-platform information system of climate control of buildings.

articleTitle: Information Support of Devices for Determining Antioxidant Activity by Concentration of Oxygen Based on A Luminescent Sensitive Element
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper analyzes the main photophysical processes involving excited phosphor and oxygen molecules and reveals the relationship between the oxygen concentration and the integrated luminescence intensities in the absence and presence of oxygen. It is shown that the implementation of the method based on the measurement of the energy characteristics of luminescence can be brought to instrumentation by using a relatively simple measuring technique. In addition, a description is given of available devices for measuring the concentration of oxygen in liquid and gaseous media based on optical methods, and also their disadvantages are identified. A device is proposed for the quantitative determination of the antioxidant activity of a sample by oxygen concentration based on the integrated luminescence intensities of the luminescence in the absence and in the presence of oxidized oxygen. The structural diagram and principle of operation of the proposed device are illustrated. The results of the work can be applied in determining the antioxidant activity of food products.

articleTitle: Information Security Issues For Travel Companies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article deals with the theoretical and methodological foundations of scientific research of information aspects of tourism security. The place of the concepts of "tourism security" and the information component in the structure of the category "tourism security" are defined. The key problems of information security of travel companies due to information threats are identified. The essence and ways of providing certain components of information security of tourism are characterized. The prospects of further research of information aspects of tourism security are determined.

articleTitle: Development of Creativity of Learners in the Courses of Advanced Training and Retraining of Pedagogical Staff in the Process of Studying the Course ”Innovative Educational Technology”
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article devoted to the methodology for the development of creative learning of higher educational institutions' teachers in advanced training courses and retraining of pedagogical staff in the areas of computer science, mathematics and physics. The course “Innovative educational technologies” includes concepts as creativity, creative learning, organizational and pedagogical conditions of creative learning, and stages of development of creativity of pedagogical staff.

articleTitle: Practical application of methods of visual modeling in object-oriented design of information systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article describes the classic methods of object-oriented design using modern software tools. Among these methods, designing on visual language UML, application of design patterns, use of elements of CASE-technology to generate basic elements software system, the widespread implements of reuse, component architecture of the software system, taking advantage provided by modern approaches such as containerization. At the end, an example of designing part of an information system with using the mentioned methods, modern software tools, such as Docker for encapsulating and quickly deploying services, ArgoUML, for visual iterative design and ArchGenXML for components code generation.

articleTitle: To The Problem Of Forming Creative Information-Communication Competence Of The Principal Of General Education School
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The research is devoted to the actual problem of formation of creative information and communication competence of the principals of general education schools brought to life by the requests of the information society. The creative information and communication competency of the principal of general education school is the integration of the principal of the school for the creative use of modern information and communication technologies (ICT) into the professional and managerial activities. The respondents to this study were 102 principals of general education schools of the Republic of Uzbekistan. Data collection was carried out on the basis of a three parts questionnaire. The first part of the questionnaire collects information from respondents about knowledge in the field of modern ICT and the principles of the formation of an information and educational environment. The second part of the questionnaire contains information about the activities of the school principal in the information and educational environment. The third part of the questionnaire is aimed at elucidating the motives and attitude of the school principal towards innovation in the field of ICT. These profiles were summarized and analyzed as a percentage. The results show that the principals of general education schools have a low and medium level of creative information and communication competence, which confirms the hypothesis about the need for the formation of creative information and communication competence of the school principal in advanced training courses for leading cadres of Public Education.

articleTitle: Verification of the pocket filtering based on method of verification on the model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)

articleTitle: Assessment Features And Appearance Reasons Of Risks In E-payment Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article to the study of the development of electronic payment systems is devoted. The article issues of risk identification and assessment, approaches to risk prevention in the field of electronic payments is considers. There is access to new technologies of wallets, which allows you to use various features in electronic payment systems, allowing you to make payments with high speed, high security.

articleTitle: Information Technology in Cinematography
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The introduction of IT or digital technology in all spheres of human life is called the fourth industrial revolution. However, apart from the undoubted advantages, any revolution brings a number of problems. The authors investigate problems of how digital technologies help artists of the world cinema and how they influence it.

articleTitle: A Study on Life Cycle Cost on Railway Switches and Crossings
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Switches and crossings (S&Cs) are one of the vital subsystems in railway. The main function of an S&C is to help trains to safely move from one track to another track. To do this, an S&C consists of movable and fixed mechanical parts, as well as signaling and electrical systems. Each of these systems requires a proper maintenance and is susceptible to failures which ultimately lead to train disturbances. The aim of the paper is to carry out life cycle cost analysis for railway S&C which operate over more 40 years. We decompose the life cycle of the S&C and break down them into subsystems to identify which of them requires maintenance. We demonstrated how to decide optimal S&C through cost identification and system breakdown.

articleTitle: Search for new technical solutions when designing color measuring systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: To search for new technical solutions when designing color measuring systems, we need a design object, i.e. to divide color measuring device into fragments, and solutions are sought for these fragments separately. At the first level of the partition, the color measuring device is divided into four main structural parts: the lighting, dispersing, electronic recording and computing devices.

articleTitle: Formalization Of The Criterion Of Efficiency Of The Message Management Information And Telecommunications Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the task of ensuring the efficiency of information exchange in information and telecommunication networks. The factors and methods that determine the effectiveness of information and telecommunications networks are analyzed. It is shown that the efficiency of use of network resources can be improved through the development and application of adaptive management methods. The mathematical optimization problem of choosing the most efficient network protocol is formulated.

articleTitle: Modelling of transducers of nonsymmetrical signals of electrical nets
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article given materials of modelling electromagnet transducers of nonsymmetrical signals of three phases electrical nets. Determined, that modelling electromagnet transducers of nonsymmetrical signals of three phases electrical nets of power systems require a modern mathematical method, which will submit opposite of calculate optimal construction parameters and quantities. In article electromagnet transducers of nonsymmetrical signals of three phases electrical nets modeled on the base practical and computer oriented matrise methods and analytical equations of algebraical equations systems.

articleTitle: Development of the automatic control system of the process of enrichment of technogenic waste
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: System analyze and synthesis of automatic control including fuzzy system control of technogenic waste enrichment technological process have been carried out. Current research paper proposes an adaptive control algorithm using programs for industrial logic controller. The operation of the proposed installation for multistage pneumatic separation of crushed particles of technogenic waste is described.

articleTitle: Fiber-Based Whispering Gallery Mode Microresonators for Optical Frequency Comb Generation in Telecommunication Range: Experiment and Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Optical frequency combs including microresonator-based ones can be used in telecommunications as multi-carrier sources in wavelength-division multiplexing. We produced samples of silica fiber-based spherical microresonators potentially interesting for this application. Whispering gallery modes were excited by broadband spontaneous emission radiation of an Er:fiber laser source. Q-factors were estimated. We also investigated theoretically the possibility of using silicabased GeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-doped glass microspheres for comb generation in the dissipative soliton regime pumped at 1550 nm. It was shown numerically that optical frequency combs with a spectral width from E-band to L-band can be obtained for microspheres doped with 20 mol.% GeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Analysis of Integrated Neural Network Attack Detection System and User Behavior Models
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article describes the definitions of network attacks through neural networks and how to group them into coordinates. An interactive model of user actions and a neural network attack detection system are described.

articleTitle: Development of an information and logistics system “InfLog-CredSys” for managing big data in the yii framework for use in a credit training system
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article describes the development of the INFLOG-CredSys information system based on the created special database. The structure of the created database is given. The fully developed main interface of the INFLOG-CredSys system is fully provided. In this article, a special information database has been created in the YII FRAMEWORK system environment, which uses the MVC (Model-View-Controller) architectural pattern directly and is intended for the rapid development of modern web applications. In order to work with big data, intermediate interfaces have been developed for exchanging information. The INFLOG-CredSys application works in local computing networks with access to the Internet. The INFLOG-CredSys application is developed based on the Yii Framework. In conclusion, we note that this INFLOG-CredSys application can certainly be used and will be applied in all higher educational institutions, where the education process is based on the credit system.

articleTitle: Handling of Transmission of Numeral Signals of Telecommunication by Means of Programmed Logical Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In article, it is stated principles of creation of programmed logical integrated circuits and digital signal processing methods. Are resulted on a specific example process of formation code sequence the meaning code of required station in signal transmission devices in fiber optical systems.

articleTitle: Analytical and numerical reconstruction of internal structure of the objects in a family of straight-line segments
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We considered a problem of reconstruction function in a strip, if we know the integrals of sought function in the family of straight-line segments with a given weight function of a special kind. We obtained an analytical representation of solution in the class of smooth finite functions, the uniqueness theorems for solution of the problem is proved. The stability estimate of solution in Sobolev spaces is presented, which implies its weakly ill-posedness. These theoretical results are used in order to recover the internal structure objects from their integral data. Numerical results and their graphical representation are given.

articleTitle: New Aspects Of The Behavior Of The Photovoltaic Effect In Series-Connected Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: It has been experimentally shown that the direct voltage and current of the photodiode in the photovoltaic regime strongly depend on the width of the forbidden band of the semiconductor material, the type of the load and its resistance. Schemes of series-connected photodiodes in the photovoltaic mode with a nonlinear load on a bipolar transistor perform the function of a radiation sensor.

articleTitle: Using the methods and optimizing criteria in making the managing decisions of agricultural production
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article forming the multi-criteria stochastic tasks of placing and specialization the agricultural production, choosing the criteria according to the condition, usage of solving methods and irradiating the algorithms of numerical solving is analyzed.

articleTitle: One of the Methods for Assessing the Reliability of a Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Annotation. To assess the reliability of the communication network, a functional indicator is proposed that takes into account not only the flows of failures and recoveries, but also control methods and the flows of transmitted information over the network.

articleTitle: Communication And Information Technology Is A Way Of Changing Education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article deals with information and communication technologies as methods of increasing of study activity of students in the process of learning English language. Implementation of information and communication technologies in study process leads to improvement of academic effectiveness, increase of students' interest in self- knowledge, their motivation and comfort in the study process. It also helps to build-up students self-work.

articleTitle: Aproaches to the Construction of Fuzzy Models of Intellectual Analysis of the State of the Low-Formalized Processes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper three approaches to the construction of fuzzy models for the intellectual analysis of the state of weakly formalized processes, described by the rules of fuzzy inference, are considered. Parameters for different kinds of membership functions are defined. The solution of the multicriteria optimization problem, which arises in the construction of the model of the intellectual analysis of the states of weakly formalized processes.

articleTitle: Study of a transmission-reception system of the voice signal of increased security on the basis of generator of chaotic osillations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper presents the research results of the developed receiver and transmitter with increased confidentiality of messages. Studies were conducted to identify possible circuit solutions and determine the general principles of the system based on the signals of chaotic generators to hide information from unauthorized access.

articleTitle: A mathematical model of the diffusion process of sewage and channel waters mixing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The diffusion of salt water from a sewage source into the flowing fresh water of the channel is discussed in the paper. Water pollution distribution along the channel length is investigated and an analytical formula is given to determine the path length of complete mixing of sewage and fresh waters. Molecular diffusion in flowing channel waters is considered.

articleTitle: Calculating methodology for information characteristics on chemical preprojection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In order to introduce generalized assessments of the degree of perfection of technological schemes of chemical-technological systems, the basic information characteristics of chemical-technological systems that can be determined from the statistical processing of random functions of the output coordinates of these systems are considered. The methods of calculation information characteristics objects Chemical Technology on thermodynamic analysis operation example monoethanolamine separating gas purification at a chemical plant.

articleTitle: Professional Competence of A Foreign Language Teacher in A Technical University
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of professional competence of a foreign language teacher in a technical university. The author has developed a model of professional competence based on the analysis of the conditions of a teacher's activity. A conclusion has been made about the importance of a professional component in the competence structure.

articleTitle: Research and comparative analysis of phaso-inverter cascades with single-polar power supply
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article provides a comparative analysis of phase inverter cascades on various types of transistors. Calculations are given for various types of transistors for further selection of the best of them according to the load characteristic and resistance values, which will later be used to model the operation of the circuit.

articleTitle: Graph Representation Of The Mechanism Of Exchange Of Information Flows In Computer Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The problem of parametric synthesis of multiservice telecommunication systems is considered. The peculiarity of telecommunication systems is a multilayer structure formed by superimposed networks and the presence of self-similarity effect in the transmitted flows. When describing the structure of the projected telecommunication system, it is proposed to use a multilayer graph, and to model flows in the network, to use models of self-similar processes. The solution of the parametric synthesis problem is reduced to the nonlinear programming problem, which is solved using the gradient descent method.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of the convection process near a vertically located source
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article simulated the process of the emergence of dynamic and temperature boundary layers near a vertically located rod, which is a heat source. The formulated system of partial differential equations with boundary conditions is solved numerically and its algorithm is implemented using the DELPHI graphical environment. The Chart component was used to draw graphs.

articleTitle: Perfection Of Standard Documents And System Requirements In The Field Quality Of Service NGN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: It is resulted results of researches by calculation of network characteristics and estimations of quality characteristics of service in networks of following generation, methodical recommendations about perfection of standard documents in the field of quality of service NGN are made, it is offered methods of calculation of probability of timely delivery of packets, variations of a time delay of packets and probability of readiness of a network.

Author Keywords: probability of timely delivery of packets
a variation of a time delay of packets and probability of readiness of a network

articleTitle: The Axiomatic Approach to Definition of Interval Relations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted pressing question of the interval analysis, definition of relations of an order between intervals. Interval relations are widely used at the decision of problems of optimization, decision-making and management in the conditions of interval uncertainty. In article, the concept of function of an estimation of interval relations of an order, and an axiom with which estimation function should satisfy is entered. Based on estimation, function it is entered relations of comparison and its equivalence to the usual relation of an order is proved

articleTitle: Maximitazion Of Shareholders Wealth As A Primary Goal Of A Firm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this study we investigate maximization of shareholders wealth in financial operations. We revealed that the budgetary chief can best serve business people by identifying stock and undertakings that improve the firm in light of the fact that the business focus needs and regard what the firm offers. We also examine the fundamental aim of assignment. Issues on maximization benefit, weaknesses of PM and the monetary market are widely discussed in the paper. We also investigated that the Financial boss has the obligation to act in their best interest. It was revealed that cash related organization covers broad assortment of issues, for instance, budgetary angles, financing and accounting. Objectives of affirmation of possible threats and benefit, monetary adequacy, wander valuation advantage may be reinvested, created off or paid in benefits. The idea that each objective financial specialist, at a given level of hazard, will acknowledge just the biggest expected return. That is, given two ventures at precisely the same of hazard, every other thing being equivalent, each objective financial specialist will put resources into the one that offers the higher return. The Markowitz Portfolio Theory endeavours to scientifically distinguish the portfolio with the most noteworthy return at each level of hazard.

articleTitle: A Procedure for Solving a Problem of Classification with Functions for Comparing Multi-Type Features
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper presents an approach for classifying objects describing via multi-type feature. A problem of classification on based (precedents of) training set. Multi-type features divide several groups, and for each group of features special elementary logical classifiers will be built. Here, the focus is on features expressed by fuzzy sets. Part of the result is a comparison of the values of one fuzzy sign.

articleTitle: Optimization of the structure of communication networks by cost criterion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The following article is dedicated to the optimization of the structure of digital telecommunications networks by the criterion of network-wide reduced costs. The mathematical model for calculating the cost parameters of digital communication networks have been worked out. Numerical results of the structure optimization by the criterion given network-wide costs for various network parameters have been received.

articleTitle: Virtual Fence Moving Algorithm for Circulated Grazing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, we describe one of the main functions of virtual fencing. Virtual fencing is a method of controlling animals without ground fencing. Control is carried out by changing the behavior of the animal with the help of one or more sensory prompts, introduced to the animal after it has tried to penetrate the border created by the software. This border can have any geometric shape, and although it is not visible to the eye. The proposed algorithm handles to move the animals’ group from one fence to another one without using human physical activity. The algorithm creates a new temporal way that covers both fences and allows animals to move between fences safely. The temporal moving tunnel location calculates based on fences location coordinates, and moving process executes by using GPS signals that come from device set on the animal’s neck.

articleTitle: Informational ensuring innovative management of higher education system
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article presents the main aspects of the information support of innovative management. In particular, the principles of their creation and functioning are given, and the means of optimization and development of information support for innovative management are studied.

articleTitle: Intellectual algorithms and information systems for the education process
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article discusses the modern approach to the learning process - the use of intelligent information systems in the education system and their algorithms. The use of intelligent information systems in education will enhance the effectiveness of education and the formation of talented future personnel. One of the most pressing problems of our time is the development of targeted, informative and applied technologies for the specialization of sciences as a new approach to the organization of the process of professional and individual development of students in the educational process.

articleTitle: ICT Terminologies In Learning English
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Corpus linguistic will be the one of latest and fast method for teaching and learning of different languages. Proposed article can provide the corpus linguistic introduction and give the general overview about the linguistic team of corpus. Article described about the corpus, novelties and corpus are associated in the following field. Proposed paper can focus on the using the corpus linguistic in IT field. As from research it is obvious that corpora will be used as internet and primary data in the field of IT. The method of text corpus is the digestive approach which can drive the different set of rules to govern the natural language from the text in the particular language, it can explore about languages that how it can inter-related with other. Hence the corpus linguistic will be automatically drive from the text sources.

articleTitle: Research of magnetic circuits magnetoelastic sensors efforts with the method for creating equivalent circuits
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article investigates the magnetic circuits of magnetoelastic force sensors without taking into account and taking into account the distribution of the magnetizing windings by drawing up the equivalent circuit. It is shown that taking into account the distribution of the magnetizing forces of the excitation winding sections in the calculations significantly reduces the error in the calculation of the magnetic circuits. It is found that with the increase in the number of cascade-connected sections of the magnetic circuit in the equivalent circuit, the calculation errors decrease.

articleTitle: Enhancing ICT Technologies in Teaching, Learning and Assessment of foreign languages in Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the digital era integrating ICT technologies to Teaching, Learning and Assessment is important in developing learners’ 21st centuary skills. Thus, studying the issues of effective application of ICT tools and challanges in teaching, leraning and assessment can help educators in overcoming obstacles and successfully integrate ICT to education process. A quantitative research method was used to collect the data from university teachers in Uzbekistan. It is hoped that evidence on effective applications of ICT and challenges in integrating ICT to teaching and assessment will provide proper information for teachers to integrate modern technologies into education process.

articleTitle: Ways of Improving Marketing Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Communication plays a huge role in balanced development of global economy. It serves as a link between industrial sphere, sphere of services and consumers, and also between the remote territories and the economic centres. Stimulating dialogue of people by means of communication, modern facility of telecommunication means a necessary condition for social rallying and cultural development of all countries.

articleTitle: Development of Media Competency of Students of Pedagogical Universities in the Process of Studying the Course ”Computer Sciences and Information Technologies”
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article discusses the methodology for the development of media competency of students of pedagogical higher educational institutions based on the improvement of knowledge and skills in the field of media in the process of studying the course “Computer sciences and information technologies The content of the course “Computer sciences and information technologies” improved by media knowledge, media competencies and their contents, as well as criteria and levels of development of media competency of students of pedagogical higher educational institutions are offered.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Of Virtual Simulation Of Three-Dimensional Objects In The Development Of Culture And Professional Skills Of The Audience Of The Project
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The effectiveness of various graphic programs that use 3D simulation of three-dimensional graphics to develop a design culture and professional skills of the audience is described in the paper; an example of vertical simulation of the Apparel platform, of one of the hydraulic structures in the AutoCAD graphic program is given.

articleTitle: Statistical properties of a periodically modulated radiation in a multimode fibers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We have measured the photon statistics of modulated laser radiation passed through a multimode optical fiber. A dependence is found of the photocount number variance on the average power of the radiation coupled into the fiber. The relations of the photocount probability distribution P(n) to frequency and percentage modulation of the radiation, as well as from length and excitation condition of optical fiber were studied.

articleTitle: Development of Algorithms Accepting Diagnostic Decisions with the use of Neuro-Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the paper the algorithm for constructing a fuzzy model for diagnosing the state of weakly formalized processes, which allows solving the problems of classification, estimation and forecasting of the states of processes under conditions of weakly structured and uncertain information about these processes are considered. On the basis of mathematical analysis it is shown that it is important to ensure the adequacy of the model, that is, how correctly the current information on the subject of research is used in the modeling process.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Low Cost Laser Scanner for Rapid Registration of Point Clouds with Limited Information on Rotation and Relative Location
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Laser scanners are becoming more affordable. The cost of a laser scanner has been driven down by the high demand for range measuring devices used in autonomous cars. The objective of this paper is to evaluate usage of a cost effective laser scanner for rapid mapping of a building's interior. One of the valuable applications of such devices is for quick structural assessments during reconnaissance efforts right after an earthquake, when measuring a plan of the interior of the building is beneficial for further analysis. Due to safety and the large number of buildings under investigation, researchers have a very limited amount of time to remain inside of the building and get the critical measurements. Having a tool that can create layouts of the interior while a person is moving inside would be beneficial for applications of this kind. For mass application, cost of the device is an important factor. The scanner used in this application creates a plane point cloud. In a horizontal orientation, it creates a horizontal slice of the building's interior that can capture the locations of the openings (doors and windows) and the general dimensions of the room. When the stitching of the laser scans is done on the fly, the floor plan of a large building can be measured with adequate accuracy in a short period of time. The point clouds registered in real-time and transferred over a network have a strong potential to become a very important component in the Internet of Things, a system of interrelated computing devices, mechanical and digital machines, and sensors. This work assumes that information about the orientation of the scanner and its relative location is very limited and as such, the registration of the point clouds is based on the use of common features.

articleTitle: The solution to the problem of synthesis of control of multidimensional objects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: A method for the synthesis of control systems for multidimensional objects by the gradient-velocity method of Lyapunov vector functions is proposed. The gradient-velocity method of Lyapunov vector functions solves the problem of synthesis of automatic control systems using m-input and n-output parameters of an object directly from the matrix elements of a closed system. Changing the parameters of a controller, that provides specified transient characteristics of a closed system. The basic provisions of the Lyapunov theorem on asymptotic stability and the concept of stability of dynamical systems are used.

Author Keywords: controller synthesis system with m-n-inputs and outputs

articleTitle: Image Filtering Algorithm Based On The Analysis Of The Main Components
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: the paper considers an algorithm that allows to solve the problem of filtering images based on the analysis of the main components, also presents simulation results showing the main features of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Situational Management of Complex Information Systems Based on Fuzzy Correspondence Models
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the situational management of complex information systems using the fuzzy correspondence models. The structure of the model, the algorithm for its implementation, and application aspects for solving applied problems in various fields are considered. The model and software are used to create and operate situational expert systems with fuzzy logic. Advantages of the model and approach for solving applied problems is given too.

articleTitle: How we can calculate average data rate of broadband access from rural settlement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: High speed applications require the access network upgrading based on new optical technologies in “last mile”. Designed algorithm simplifies the throughput calculation of current access nodes and planning of new access nodes depending on subscriber's requirements to the broadband services. Considering method is based on average transfer data rate from all sources and equivalent data throughput assigned with peak rate. This article is discussed how you can calculate average data rate for rural settlement.

articleTitle: Factors Of Information Technologies in Intercultural Integration Process
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The social and political trends of information technology development in Uzbekistan in connection with international community, its involvement in the field of information technology, observations and comparative analysis of international experience are described in this article. It also provides information on inter-state relations; political, economic, social, legal and cultural work within the global information system; statistical indicators of work efficiency through e-mail, e-information exchange addressing both national and global problems.

articleTitle: Formation Relational Structures of Dataset of the Insecta Orthopteroidea for Identification Models
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, we consider an integration of information technology with biology, which made it possible for specialists to further explore the subject area. The objects of research are taken by the Insects Orthopteroidea of Uzbekistan. An information-identification software complex has been created for this kind and a systematic morphological analysis of information on taxa of a large number of samples of representatives of insects of orthopteroidea has been carried out.

Author Keywords: morphological analysis of information on taxa

articleTitle: Multifunctional Heat Converter Moisture Content of Liquid Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article presents the results of a study of the operating modes of a multifunctional thermal converter of liquid materials and gives its static characteristics. The developed multifunctional heat transducer moisture content of liquid materials allows you to determine the humidity of various water solutions in a wide.

Author Keywords: moisture content of a liquid material

articleTitle: Estimating of National Economy’s Investment Attraction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Investors which wish to enclose the means first of all analyze not only object of investment, but both an investment climate of the country and development degree of the branch. Uzbekistan possesses huge investment potential. For years of independence thanks to realization of deeply thought over and purposeful program of economic reforming and country modernization high rates of economic growth is provided in Uzbekistan. For the first quarter of current year the gain of a total internal product has made 7.6 percent, volumes of manufacture of an industrial output -6.2 percent, including consumer goods -10.3 percent, services -12.6 percent. The state budget is executed with proficiency at a rate of more than 0.3% to a total internal product. The rate of inflation has not exceeded expected parameters.Taken measures on the world supports and to stimulation of activity the enterprise -the exporter and to competitiveness increase domestic production on sale foreign markets have provided growth of volumes of export on 28.5% and considerable positive balance of the foreign trade turnover.

articleTitle: Language In The System of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of one of the approaches to the definition of rationality. Researchers who develop this approach argue that the essential signs of conscious behavior can be identified based on a consideration of how a person uses his natural language in communicative actions. In this case, the above general problem begins to be discussed at the linguistic level. Artificial intelligence is also a communicative system. In this case, a special language-interface is used, which provides an interactive form of interaction between a human and a computer, i.e., their communication. The question arises: does computer use the language in the same way as a human? If we can answer this question positively, then the AI system will be attributed to the property of rational behavior, if the answer is negative, then we will be able to find out what the computer lacks in order to rise to the level of human consciousness.

articleTitle: Analysis of Prospects of Technology of Intelligent Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
