abstract: In the paper the analysis of the perspective of the technology of intelligent monitoring systems is conducted, as intellectualization is the main direction of development of modern technologies, and the property of intellectuality should be inherent in all the latest information management systems. Various strategies for intellectualization of monitoring are aimed at implementing intellectual information support for decision-makers using monitoring tools. Such support can be realized by building fuzzy linguistic databases/knowledge together with fuzzy inference subsystems, and information for decision making can be displayed on the automated workplace of the decision maker.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal Airy beam modulated by elegant Laguerre and elegant Gaussian function in free space
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Airy elegant Gaussian beam is the airy beam which is modulated by the elegant Gaussian. According to the (2+1)D paraxial wave equation describing the wave propagation of the electric field, Airy elegant Gaussian solution to the paraxial wave equation in spatial field are accessed. The solution of the Airy-Elegant-Largeurre-Gaussian(AiELG) beam, which is the spatiotemporal Airy elegant Gaussian beam modulated by the elegant Larguerre function, can be accessed by solving the (3+1)D Schrödinger equation in the free space. We found that their intensity profiles are determined by three parameters: the azimuthal mode number, the radial mode number and the modulation depth. It is worth mentioning that the radial mode number of AiELG wave packet will change in propagation.

articleTitle: Methods of Obtaining Z-solutions of a Multi-criterial Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, considered approaches to obtaining Z-solutions of a multicriterial problem to obtain a sustainable solution it is desirable to have additional a priori information on the degree of preference for a particular goal, which is specified by various fuzzy operators. A set of fuzzy sets corresponding to various properties of the object of investigation, in particular, qualitative (linguistic) and quantitative information about the characteristics of the object is determined. Proposed the Z-numbers approach to the prediction problem as a multicriterial problem, which reduces to some combination of fuzzy selection criteria, and to the study of complex systems as a hierarchical structure, since in order to obtain a scientifically based forecast, it is often necessary to attract information from social and natural sciences, in which the apparatus of fuzzy sets and Z-numbers is also preferable.

articleTitle: Development Of A Hydrogeological Simulation Model Of Geofiltration Processes In Regional Aquifers Of Fergana Valley
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the article it is considered the information support of the system of modeling the hydrogeological processes based on geographical information system (GIS) technology for processing spatially distributed the information to experience with creations geodatabase of underground water resources. In the research the main graphic properties of a real object are adequately reflected, which have been allowed to understand the nature of the object, to create mathematical models, to accurately determine the types of water exchange and to reduce the amount of expensive hydro-geological experiments. The aim of the research is to increase the effectiveness of methods for mathematical modeling of geofiltration processes of regional hydrogeological systems.

articleTitle: Scene Text Detection and Localization using Fully Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Early methods for text detection in scene images have obtained encouraging achievements over several benchmarks. Nevertheless, they commonly drop when working with challenging situations, although implemented by using deep learning designs. In this research, we introduce a robust yet simple pipeline that produces accurate and fast text detection in natural scene images. The pipeline quickly predicts text of random orientations in full-color images, discarding redundant intermediate stages, with a single neural network. The proposed method experimented on ICDAR 2015 and MSRA-TD500 datasets and an advantage in detecting text from natural scene images efficiently for assisting the visually impaired.

articleTitle: Integration of virtual reality and 3D modeling use of environments in education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This text deals with the design of virtual reality systems. It is also said here that the results reached with the use of the developed software show the attributes that make the ideal virtual reality for situations of research and learning taking the discipline as a reference of the classroom to the computer labs and making more interesting to the student, making the learning easy. Also of note is the fear that is characteristic only for VR in the field of education. Modern e-learning technology has many advantages, but they gradually reduce the share of the direct dialogue between teacher and student. Teacher replaced by interactive content, and the student instead of the person interacts with its simplified virtual model. The introduction of e-learning technologies must not become an end in itself. It requires a careful and balanced approach when implementing all new in education. Based on the experience of implemented development VR content in education can be noted that technology brings positive results when it is using by short sessions or as simulators and trainers. It is inappropriate to use VR for lectures and seminars. In addition to reviews how virtual reality has been used in education, discusses the advantages and disadvantages of using these technologies in the classroom, and describes how virtual reality and augmented reality technologies can be used to enhance teaching at the Samarkand branch of the Tashkent University of information technologies named after Muhammad al-Khwarizmi.

articleTitle: Dialogue Algorithm of Adoption of Multi-criterial Decisions in the Fuzzy Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the paper an interactive algorithm for the adoption of multi-criteria solutions in a fuzzy environment are discussed. Due to the specific features of multi-objective tasks and decision criteria in a fuzzy environment, human-computer technologies and methods have been widely used in recent times, which are also called interactive or interactive. The approach to making a decision in a risk environment, since with a comprehensive risk assessment are considered, it would be necessary to establish for each absolute or relative value of possible losses the corresponding probability of occurrence of such a value. This approach allows us to formalize in a unified form and use all available heterogeneous information, which increases the reliability and quality of decisions made.

articleTitle: Analysis and research of capacity, latency and other characteristics of backbone multiservice networks based on simulation modeling using different routing protocols and routers from various manufacturers for using the results when designing and modernization of multiservice networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper provides a methodology of developing a IP/MPLS backbone multiservice network model for studying traffic behavior, its capacity, latency and other characteristics of different classes, developing the network model architecture, studying the parameters of network equipment, routing technology when using different routing protocols and routers from various manufacturers. The simulation results can be used for designing and modernization of backbone multiservice networks.
